summary: Phase 1 dual Human | Combined | AI views (web only). Backend GET /api/chats/{chat_id}/ai-discussions verified for member (200 with correct shape), non-member (404), bogus chat (404); human message send verified NOT to bill AI credits or create a discussion. Frontend verified end-to-end on chat d77a7d2a-b6e9-4923-89cd-54a21880c6a6 (AIConv Test): default view is HUMAN, Human shows 8 ai-research-cards and 0 Synthesized badges (raw AI answers hidden), Combined shows 0 cards + 4 Synthesized badges + 'Show all comparisons' (regression), AI dashboard renders (1 group · 8 items · search box · items testable). Clicking a research card in Human view AND an item in AI view both open ai-discussion-panel with ai-panel-close, ai-panel-expand (which opens fullscreen-comparison) and ai-panel-resize present. Per-user+per-chat persistence key format `tn:chatview:{userId}:{chatId}` confirmed in localStorage. composer-destination pill shows 'To: Everyone · human chat', composer-switch-ai correctly prepends '@ai ' to the draft, and the previously-shipped inline @ai popover (ai-model-inline-popover) still shows on '@ai ' typing (regression pass).

issues: Text renders as 'To: Everyone· human chat' — the middle-dot separator is missing a space before it (missing space between 'Everyone' and '·'). Cosmetic only. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/chat/ChatComposer.jsx

The chat-view-human / chat-view-combined / chat-view-ai buttons don't set an `aria-pressed` attribute for screen readers. Suggest adding aria-pressed={view===...} on each toggle button. Not a functional blocker (visual active state is present). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/chat/ChatHeader.jsx

action_items: (Cosmetic) Add a leading space before the middle-dot in composer-destination pill so 'Everyone · human chat' reads naturally.
(A11y) Add aria-pressed={active} to the chat-view-human/combined/ai buttons in ChatHeader.jsx for screen readers.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/chats.py list_chat_ai_discussions() correctly filters by chat membership (404 for non-members verified) and returns visibility default 'chat'. Good.
frontend Chats.jsx L860-874: per-user+per-chat localStorage view persistence uses `tn:chatview:{user.id}:{chatId}` key exactly per spec; default falls back to 'human' correctly. Verified.

MessageList Human-view transform correctly collapses ai_question+ai_answer pairs into a single ai-research-card while preserving the user's own '@ai …' human bubbles (visible in Human view screenshot).

AiDiscussionsDashboard search filter narrows visible items but does NOT show ai-discussions-empty when filter yields 0 (empty-state is reserved for 'chat has no research'). Per-spec this is intentional; verify with UX if a 'no-match' state is desired.
